text:
Erin (CSM): Quick kickoff for Hearthwell onboarding — pilot target Mon Apr 7. Goal: production-ready inference pipeline for their search-assist feature. Need owners for infra (VPC/peering), SSO, prompts/quality, enablement. Proposed success criteria below. Can folks pick owners and flag blockers? @Sam can you confirm contract/renewal constraints?

Sam (AE): Renewal hard date 2026-11-01. Trial credits expire 2026-05-01. If adoption lags this is a renewal risk — I will keep exec touchpoints scheduled.

Ryan (SE): I can own infra + health checks. Need region preference and VPC CIDR from Hearthwell. ETA for VPC peering + smoke test: 2026-04-09. Will post health output here.

Priya (SE): I'll take SSO/SCIM. Please share SAML metadata and SCIM user list. Also need to confirm if any PII flows in prompts/attachments. @Erin, does customer accept hashed IDs only?

Alan (Onboard Eng): Draft 30/60/90 plan:
- 0-30: VPC peering + SSO, upload first prompt set, perf baseline
- 31-60: QoE tuning (prompt templates, batching), cost/quantization experiments
- 61-90: Rollout to 3 consumer teams, ops playbook + runbook handover
I'll set concrete dates after infra confirms.

Maria (Success Ops): I'll schedule a 45m enablement workshop during week of 2026-04-14 and own the feedback survey. Will capture adoption signals and training gaps.

Erin (CSM): Proposed success criteria:
- Integration: SSO + VPC established and verified
- Performance: p50 < 80ms, p99 < 400ms on pilot prompt distribution
- Quality: eval set pass rate >= 90% on priority prompts (customer to provide)
- Adoption: 3 internal teams at ~1k reqs/day each by end of week 8
- Cost: token-level baseline captured and within PO expectations

Erin (CSM): Blockers: legal needs data-flow diagram and retention policy; product needs eval set from Hearthwell. @Sam can you loop legal and secure the doc? @Priya @Alan can you draft a minimal eval set template for them?

redwood-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.app/runbooks/hearthwell-onboard — checklist added:
```
- SSO configured
- VPC peering verified
- Perf smoke test passed
- Enablement scheduled
- Eval set uploaded
```

Ryan (SE): Copy that — I'll post the healthcheck output here after peering test.

Priya (SE): Reaching out to customer for SAML metadata and to confirm PII policy today.

Sam (AE): I'll coordinate the legal intro and schedule an exec touchpoint the week after enablement.

Erin (CSM): If no major blockers by EOW I'll mark kickoff complete and create Jira milestone (Onboard: Hearthwell - VPC + SSO). :thumbsup:
